# Landscape brief: Gig economy worker wellbeing

This is a non-systematic, exploratory literature brief -- a bounded, orienting search across two connectors, not a systematic or scoping review.

## Prior work identified so far

- Closest on existing reviews: Alvarez & Tan (2023) is itself a systematic review of algorithmic management and gig worker mental health outcomes.
- Closest on population/outcome: Mensah (2022) surveyed ride-hailing drivers and reported burnout prevalence associated with shift length and platform rating pressure.
- Closest on method: Fournier & Osei (2021) used qualitative interviews to explore income precarity and subjective wellbeing among freelance platform workers.

## What this did not search

This search covered OpenAlex and Crossref only, over a single bounded query, and did not extend to grey literature, preprints, or citation chasing.

## Candidate gaps

- Is there quantitative synthesis anywhere linking specific platform design features (e.g. rating systems) to wellbeing outcomes, beyond single-study associations?
